# Blender Asset QA

Mandatory review gate for any mesh or asset created or edited in Blender: checks z-fighting, floating or detached parts, inverted or inconsistent normals, non-manifold or open geometry, degenerate faces, duplicate vertices, n-gons, unapplied scale, UV problems and bad skin weights with numbers first, then renders multi-angle review sheets, under game, render, print or Roblox profiles.
